description: Agent <-> Server WebSocket protocol for Living Water Audio Control.
transport: WebSocket (WSS in FULL). Agent dials out; no inbound ports on the camp device.
auth: First frame from agent is {kind:'auth', device_id, token, app_version}. Server replies auth_ok/auth_error.

rules.ttl: Immediate commands carry expires_at. Agent must reject expired commands.
rules.idempotency: Agent persists processed command_ids; a command_id is executed at most once, even across reconnect.
rules.no_replay: After reconnect the agent does not replay old PLAY/STOP commands.
rules.heartbeat: Every HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS. Backend marks OFFLINE after DEVICE_OFFLINE_AFTER_SECONDS.
